description:
A tragic end to a promising football career sent him back ten years in time. Now, he's been given the ultimate second chance. Armed with perfect knowledge of the future, he knows which players will become living legends. His new mission is scouting every hidden gems and building an unbeatable team from the ground up. In this high-stakes sports drama, the real game isn't played on the pitch it's in the back, where the battle to sign the next superstar is more ruthless than any final match.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=843001), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13189197)
